text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand the issues. I'll take care of 
reordering the supplies from our end. 
Thank you for the report.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's one more thing I'd like to 
consult you about. It's regarding the 
budget...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, those documents were just completed 
this morning. Let's head to the student 
council room to pick them up."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew... Next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is swamped with student council 
work. It seems her busy schedule is 
continuing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She makes you a little worried, doesn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've told her to take a break several 
times myself, but she just insists that 
she's 'busy right now.'
choice_data_list:
I hope we can find some way to unwind, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A distraction, you say...? Leave it to me! 
With my surprises, I shall whisk her away 
to a world of astonishment and excitement!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should we do? Would you 
mind sharing your thoughts as well?
choice_data_list:
I wonder who she'd actually listen to 
without putting up a fuss.
I wonder what her favorite flower is?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove acting obedient, huh... Nice, 
an interesting idea just came to mind!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well then, I should head to the 
student council room soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh? Who's there?
Yoo-hoo, Air Groove? How've you been~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Whaaat?? N-No way...!? That voice 
is...!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-Mother!? Why are you here!?
I ended up coming.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really here"?! Wait...! I-I'm so 
sorry! Please give me two minutes! I need 
to clean my room...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that the room is messy, just 
please wait a tiny bit longer...! ...Is 
this the perfect spot for the vase... 
Facebook!?

Ah, it's okay, just stay right there and 
listen. I heard from your friend that 
you've been pushing yourself way too hard 
lately, you know~?

No can do~ You've gotta relax more! Why 
don't you go hang out with some friends 
and take your mind off things?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood! I'm all ready, so let's 
continue inside the room! I'll open the 
door right no—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Surpriiiise!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Ngh! Damn it, it was just an 
impression...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...How dare you impersonate my mother. Do 
you have anything to say for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry!! But I was just so terribly 
worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Worry, you say?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what I said earlier when I 
was doing that voice impression? Those 
were my true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ Ah, I see. So that's what it 
was.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't like your methods, but... you do 
have a point.

That's right, Air Groove! Taking a 
breather is reaaally important, you know! 
You have such wonderful friends!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Hey, not again. Who's doing an 
impression this time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo~, Air Groove! Mommy's heeeere.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh... M-Mother!? Is that really you...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Surpri~se!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you can't be doing that. Pushing 
yourself so hard that your friends worry 
about you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Come back home this weekend and relax, 
alright? Come on now! Let's stretch our 
wings and take it easy~!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wait, Mother...!? Please wai—...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Flowers, huh... In that case, maybe we can 
use that gimmick!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew... Is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm...? Flower seeds on my desk? Did I 
possess such seeds?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap! Clap-clap-clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Pop, pop! Pop! 
Pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
W-What's going on!? What is this... 
Facebook?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kuh, what happened?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what happened, Groove-san?! You're so 
out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, huh... Well, how should I explain 
this..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An explosion suddenly went off in our 
room, and flowers burst into full bloom 
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! Fufufu, that sounds like quite 
the handful!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Is this really the time to be 
laughing...? Either way, stay sharp. 
There's no guarantee there isn't another 
bizarre trap waiting for us."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!? The room's completely 
buried in flowers!? That's a huge problem!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Dorm Leader. What are you smirking 
at? Hurry up and investigate the cause, 
then report...", {"id": 33, "en": "...Hey, 
turn around. There's a flower stuck in 
your hair.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait. You... Ngh, so that's what's going 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Surprise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Totally got played, didn't I.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How was it, the surprise? Did you enjoy 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I gathered all of Groove-san's favorite 
flowers!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You've looked so busy with work lately, so 
I was hoping these flowers might bring you 
some comfort!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Healed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Aah, I see... I guess I really have been 
pushing myself too hard lately.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Help me out, both of you. We're 
transferring all the flowers in the room 
into vases. Maybe we'll decorate the whole 
dorm with them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, so you ended up working after all♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Our "Empress" never learns, does she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, this isn't a job.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Arranging flowers is how I unwind.
